items.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued November 10 at 12:15PM PST until November 10 at 10:00PM PST by NWS San Diego CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents and surf of 3 to 7 feet expected
along west and southwest-facing beaches.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, until noon PST today.
For the Beach Hazards Statement, through this evening.

* IMPACTS...Dangerous swimming conditions due to elevated surf
and strong rip currents.
items.instruction: Remain out of the water to avoid hazardous swimming conditions.
